billing.title: Billing
billing.readOnly: Owners, admins and billing members can change the plan. You can see it.
billing.sourceTrial: Free trial of {plan}, no card needed. It ends on {date} ({days, plural, =0 {today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}). After that the workspace moves to the Free plan unless you pick a plan; nothing is deleted.
billing.sourceFree: The Free plan is free forever, also for commercial use.
billing.sourceSubscription: Billed {interval, select, year {yearly} other {monthly}}. Renews on {date}.
billing.sourceGrace: A payment failed. {plan} features stay on until {date} while the payment is retried. Update the payment method to keep them.
billing.trialWithSubscription: Your {paid} subscription is active. The trial keeps {plan} features on until {date}; then {paid} limits apply.
billing.scheduledCancel: The subscription ends on {date}. Until then nothing changes; after that the workspace moves to Free and monitors over the limit are paused, never deleted.
billing.scheduledPause: The subscription pauses on {date}. While paused nothing is charged and Free limits apply.
billing.paused: The subscription is paused. Nothing is charged and Free limits apply until you resume it.
billing.overdueLapsed: A payment is overdue and the grace period has ended, so Free limits apply. Update the payment method in the customer portal to get your plan back; nothing was deleted.
billing.downgradePending: You moved to {to}. {from} features stay on until {date}, the end of the period you already paid for.
billing.foundingOffer: Founding offer: the first 100 paying workspaces get 30% off for life. It is applied at checkout.
billing.activatingSlow: Payment received. Activation is taking longer than usual; this page updates on its own.
billing.pausedByPlan: {count, plural, one {# monitor is} other {# monitors are}} paused because of the plan limit. Upgrade to resume them, or pause others to choose which stay active.
billing.limitRegions: {count, plural, one {# region} other {# regions}} per monitor
billing.limitCredits: {count} SMS and voice credits a month
billing.unavailable: Checkout isn't set up on this server yet.
billing.blockedStatus: Resume or keep the subscription before changing plans.
billing.blockedPastDue: A payment is overdue. Update the payment method in the customer portal, then change plans.
billing.blockedPending: A plan change is waiting for the end of this period. Change the billing interval after that.
billing.blockedYearly: A yearly subscription can move to monthly at renewal, from the customer portal.
billing.blockedInterval: Keep the same billing interval when moving to a smaller plan.
billing.freeHow: Cancel the subscription to return to Free.
billing.confirmUpgrade: Upgrade to {plan} now? The difference for the rest of this period is charged to your saved payment method.
billing.confirmDowngrade: Move to {plan}? Nothing is charged now. Your current features stay on until the end of the period you paid for; then monitors over the {plan} limit are paused, never deleted.
billing.confirmRestore: Move back to {plan}? Nothing is charged now: this period is already paid for. The next renewal is charged at the {plan} price.
billing.creditsIntro: Credits pay for SMS, voice and WhatsApp alerts. Email and chat alerts are always free.
billing.creditsTotal: {count, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} left
billing.creditsIncluded: {count} from this month's plan allowance of {allowance}; unused ones expire when the month ends.
billing.creditsLow: Credits are running low. When they run out, SMS and voice alerts stop; email and chat alerts keep working.
billing.creditsNone: This plan has no SMS or voice credits. Starter and higher plans include them every month.
billing.buyNeedsPlan: Credit packs need an active Starter, Pro or Business plan.
billing.confirmBuy: Buy {credits} credits for {price}? Your saved payment method is charged now.
billing.buying: Charging your saved payment method… the credits appear here in a moment.
billing.invoicesIntro: Invoices, receipts and your card are in the secure customer portal run by Paddle, our payment provider.
billing.portalNone: Invoices appear here after your first payment.
billing.pauseHint: Pausing keeps your subscription and data. Nothing is charged while it is paused and you can resume any time.
billing.cancelIntro: The subscription runs until the end of the period you paid for. After that the workspace moves to Free: monitors over the limit are paused, never deleted, and purchased credits stay.
billing.cancelIntroPaused: The subscription is paused, so canceling takes effect right away. The workspace stays on Free; purchased credits stay.
billing.cancelReasonHint: It helps us fix what didn't work.
billing.cancelConfirm: Cancel at the end of the period

statusPages.what: Public status pages on your own domain, with components, 90-day uptime bars, incident updates and subscribers.
statusPages.meanwhile: Until then, every monitor page shows 90-day uptime and response times you can share with your team.

onCall.what: Schedules, rotations, overrides and escalation policies, with no per-seat pricing.
onCall.meanwhile: Until then, alerts go to every channel in your alert routes, with reminders while an incident stays open.

reports.what: Monthly SLA reports as PDF and CSV, and uptime history you can send to clients.
reports.meanwhile: A weekly digest already arrives by email every Monday, and the overview shows alert accuracy, response times and error budgets.

marketing.hero: Know about real outages first. Confirmed, explained, actionable.
marketing.subhead: Watchpost checks your sites and APIs from around the world, confirms each failure before it pages anyone, and lets your team acknowledge from wherever they are.

actionLink.title: Incident action
actionLink.doneAcknowledge: Acknowledged #{number}. The team has been told.

invite.title: Join a workspace
invite.signInFirst: You've been invited to a Watchpost workspace. Sign in, or create an account with the address the invitation was sent to.
invite.unavailable: This invitation can't be opened while you're signed in as {email}. It may be for another address, expired or already used.
invite.declined: Invitation declined. You can close this page.
invite.notPending: This invitation was already accepted, declined or withdrawn.

insights.budgetPaceOk: On pace to stay within the target this month.
insights.budgetPaceRisk: Downtime is using the budget {rate}× faster than the month passes; at this pace it runs out before the month ends.
insights.budgetPaceGone: The budget for this month is used up; the target is already missed.
insights.budgetsEmpty: Error budgets appear once you have monitors.
insights.confirmedFrom: Confirmed from {count} of {total} {total, plural, one {region} other {regions}} ({regions}).
insights.scopeEverywhere: Every region sees it, so it's most likely the service itself.
insights.scopeSome: Only some regions see it, so it may be a network path or a regional server.
insights.noDeliveries: No alerts were sent for this incident.
insights.tileMonitorsDown: {count, plural, one {# monitor needs attention} other {# monitors need attention}}
insights.tileAccuracyNone: No incidents in the last 30 days.
insights.tileAccuracyNote: {incidents, plural, one {# incident} other {# incidents}}, {falseAlarms, plural, =0 {no false alarms} one {# false alarm} other {# false alarms}}
insights.tileBudgetsOkNote: Every monitor is within its monthly target.
insights.tileBudgetsRisk: {count, plural, one {# monitor is} other {# monitors are}} at risk of missing the target.
insights.drillIntro: Opens a labelled test incident that goes through your real alert routes, so you know who gets paged before a real outage. Acknowledge it to finish.
insights.drillConfirm: Start an alert drill? Everyone in your alert routes will be notified.
insights.drillBanner: This is an alert drill, not a real outage. Acknowledge it to see how fast the team responds, then resolve it.
insights.whatChangedEmpty: No changes to the address, certificate, settings or response time in the 24 hours before.
insights.recentChangesEmpty: No changes in the last 24 hours.
insights.tileBudgetsNone: Budgets start with your first monitor.
insights.tileMonitorsWaiting: {count, plural, one {# monitor is} other {# monitors are}} waiting for the first check.
insights.deployIntro: Tell Watchpost when you deploy, and incidents will say "started 2 minutes after deploy abc123". Deploys also appear in each monitor's recent changes.
insights.deployConfigured: A deploy URL is set up. For security it is only shown when created; rotate it to see a new one.
insights.deployRotateConfirm: Rotate the deploy URL? The current URL and GitHub secret stop working right away.
insights.deployOnce: Copy these now: the URL and secret are shown only once.
insights.deployGithubSteps: In your repository: Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook. Use the URL and secret below, content type application/json, and pick only the "Deployment statuses" event.
insights.deploySuspect: Deploy {version} went out {minutes, plural, =0 {less than a minute} one {# minute} other {# minutes}} before this started.
insights.tuningStats: Last 30 days: {incidents, plural, one {# incident} other {# incidents}}; {falseAlarms} marked false alarm, {flapping} flapped, {shortLived} cleared within 5 minutes.
insights.tuningNone: No changes suggested: this monitor's alerts have been reliable.
insights.tuningApplied: Applied. The new settings take effect on the next check.
